title: re.finding event
description: One finding lifecycle moment from an authorized reverse-engineering analysis, published to the Studio live feed: a candidate was identified (by an analyst, a scanner, an import, or a Ghidra session), validated, confirmed, or rejected. Payload shape matches tools/findings_view.finding_event.

source.description: how the candidate entered the pipeline

binary.description: the binary/object the finding is about

function.description: the function/address the finding is localized to

evidence_ref.description: ledger ref for the decisive evidence, when set

actor.description: who moved the state (role or human)
